gradient_flow_mechanics.active_sample_gradient: d(Loss)/d(e_solexs_raw) = d(Loss)/d(e_solexs) * mask_solexs. When mask = 1.0, gradients propagate fully back through the encoder. When mask = 0.0, gradients propagate back only to the missing_token parameter, and encoder gradients are zeroed out.
gradient_flow_mechanics.feasibility_proof: Since the Training split contains a high percentage of active samples for all three instruments (100.0% GOES, 75.63% SoLEXS, 99.98% HEL1OS), and also contains a non-zero portion of missing samples, every parameter in all three encoders, all projection layers, learnable missing tokens, fusion self-attention, and the classifier head will receive non-zero gradients over the course of Stage 2 training.
